title: Is Mall World really just a large airport or train station instead?

classification.theory_summary: Speculates that 'Mall World' may be more like an airport or train station (travel hub) than a mall; references end-of-life travel dreams and cultural journey motifs.
classification.skip_reason: No first-person Mall World dream narrative or specific scene description; mostly speculation and external references.

meta.author_theory: Airports/train stations resemble labyrinthine malls with urgency/chaos/foot traffic; travel hubs are 'not quite here nor there' and may relate to end-of-life travel dreams; suggests Mall World could be a travel hub.

extraction.extraction_notes: Post contains general descriptions of airports/train stations (labyrinths, urgency, chaos, foot traffic) and a waking-life anecdote about the author's father discussing travel/hotel reservations while hospitalized, but does not describe a specific dream scene with extractable locations/connections/boundaries.
